topic.readerProblem: A founder or marketing lead has read lists of AEO tactics but cannot tell which buyer questions, engines, proof sources and metric to build a plan on, what the team should stop doing, or what to do first.
topic.connection: AEOeye audits whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity name a brand; this guide turns what those audits and our crawler study show (few answer slots, an earned-media bias, run-to-run variance) into a decision framework, a stop-doing list and a 30-day and 6-month plan for a marketing team.

assessment: The page gives the reader four explicit decisions, each with a default and a stated cost, a short list of what to stop doing, and a 30-day and 6-month plan. It rests on vendor documentation (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity and Google's July 2026 generative AI guide), an arXiv preprint, Pew and SparkToro research, and AEOeye's own audit-record aggregates, crawler access study and content consolidation, each used with its caveats. It deliberately does not claim a measured lift from our own consolidation, compare engines by mention rate, promise any timeline, or carry over unverifiable claims from the two merged pages.

sources.supports: Chen et al. (September 2025): web-enabled GPT vs Google on 1,000 consumer ranking prompts; software products (Canada) 74.2% earned / 25.8% brand for the AI engine vs 31.8% / 53.8% for Google; absolute percentages called illustrative; unbranded queries default to market leaders.
March 2025 browsing data from 900 U.S. adults: a traditional result link was clicked in 8% of visits with a Google AI summary vs 15% without.

600 volunteers, 12 prompts, 2,961 runs on ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI Overviews / AI Mode (November-December 2025); under 1 in 100 chance of the same brand list, about 1 in 1,000 for the same order; visibility percentage judged reasonable, ranking position not.

Google's generative AI guide (last updated 2026-07-10): optimizing for AI search is still SEO; you can ignore llms.txt (Google Search ignores it), chunking content, rewriting just for AI, inauthentic mentions and special schema.org markup; defines query fan-out; indexed and snippet-eligible pages are required; unique, non-commodity content likely matters most.

OAI-SearchBot surfaces sites in ChatGPT search, GPTBot is for training, settings are independent, sites opted out of OAI-SearchBot are not shown in ChatGPT search answers, search systems take about 24 hours to adjust after a robots.txt change.
Claude determines when to search; it searches for current or changing information, including products that may have changed, and answers stable-knowledge requests directly.
ClaudeBot (training) and Claude-SearchBot (search result quality) are separate crawlers.
PerplexityBot surfaces and links sites in Perplexity search and is not used to crawl content for AI foundation models.
Definition of retrieval-augmented generation as retrieving and incorporating new information from external data sources.
Defines the Organization type and its name, url and sameAs properties, cited for keeping the entity description consistent.
Definition of generative engine optimization, also known as answer engine optimization (AEO).
